svg.text: Solvay Spark Spine AI — Target Architecture on SAP BTP
Arrows = request / data direction · an arrow to a layer = used by several of its parts
Dark boxes = managed / cloud services outside the app · green = data stores · band 7 = platform services used by every component
HANA Cloud replaces PostgreSQL + pgvector and Neo4j (one instance); Gen AI Hub replaces the Anthropic API and Ollama
